إجراء:Using Digital Earth Tester type
 Terca 2

يسرد هذا المستند إجراءات الاختبار ل 
measure the earth electrode resistance by using TERCA 2 digital earth tester, The periodic testing of the earth 
resistance is required to maintain sufficiently low resistance values of 
grounding system. The test method is "fall of 
potential" or "62% method, and it is bsed on the princible of the potential drop 
across the resistance

Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and

general director.

sections.text: For the connection details see figure 2

Short circuit terminals X and Xv with the shorting 
strap provided 15 fig 2 and unshorted terminals Y and Z (shorting strap 
17)

Drive earth auger Z into the ground (to its length 
if possible) at, for example, 30 m from the earth electrode X fig 2

Drive earth auger Y into the ground on a straight 
line between X and Z and at18 m from X (62 % distance XZ)

If the audible alarm sounds, to indicate the 
presence of a voltage > 20 V peak, do not press the "TEST" pushbutton, check the 
installation, If the alarm does not sound, continue with the test.
Note down the displayed resistance value.

Move earth auger Y along the straight line between 
X and Z; firstly to 21 m from X ( 72 % distance XZ ) then back to 15 m from X 
(52 % distance XZ).

Note the resistance value for each position. (1 ohm 
to 0.9 for agriculture / 2:3 ohm for desert)

If the readings are the same within a few %, the 
earth electrode resistance measurement is correct.

If this is not the case, increase the 
distance X to Z (to 40 m for example) and repeat the test, using the same 
proportions 62 % , 72% and 52 %.
(25, 29 and 21 m approx) from X. And so on 
until a viable result is obtained.
